# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime and platform polish**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves WebAssembly packaging, Android rendering synchronization, and managed graphics memory efficiency. Apple targets now require newer operating-system versions, and front-buffered streams release managed references reliably.

## Breaking Changes

- **Apple deployment requirements raised** — iOS and tvOS targets now require version 14.0, and native macOS binaries target macOS 11.0. Retarget applications and update supported-device requirements before upgrading. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly WebGPU support is packaged with the native library** — The emdawnwebgpu implementation is compiled into libSkiaSharp, so modern .NET WebAssembly applications no longer pass its C++ source and compile flags through their final link. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Linux uses its bundled HarfBuzz symbols locally** — Linux native assets bind HarfBuzz functions from the bundled library, avoiding interference from similarly named symbols supplied by the host environment. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — GLTextureView synchronizes texture rendering with display refresh, improving the timing of Android texture presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Managed pixel and text paths avoid temporary allocations** — Pixel-copy image creation and common HarfBuzz text and feature conversions use direct or pooled buffers where possible, reducing allocation pressure without changing their results. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Front-buffered streams release retained managed streams** — Disposing a front-buffered managed stream now clears its managed stream reference even when the caller retains ownership of that stream. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
